webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: A service starts a run by sending a POST request to a trigger's URL with its token: as a bearer token in the {{header}} header, or as the {{param}} query parameter (prefer the header, since proxies log URLs). millstream apply shows each new token once.
webhooks.rotateNew: A new token is generated for {{trigger}}.
webhooks.rotateOld: The current token stops working immediately: requests that send it are refused.
webhooks.rotateSenders: Every service that calls this webhook must be updated with the new token.
webhooks.rotateOnce: The new token is shown only once, right after this.
webhooks.rotateFailed: Couldn’t rotate the token of {{trigger}}: {{message}} The current token still works.
webhooks.tokenOnce: Store it now: it will not be shown again.
webhooks.tokenLost: Millstream keeps only its hash; if it is lost, rotate the token again.
webhooks.usage: Send it with every request to the webhook:

deadLetters.migrate: Move their runs to the active revision {{revision}} first
deadLetters.migrateHint: They ran on {{revisions}}. Fixing a route usually needs it.
deadLetters.replayQueueSteps: They go back into their steps’ queues now, in their own runs.
deadLetters.replayQueue: They go back into {{step}}’s queue now, in their own runs.
deadLetters.replayMigrated: Their runs move to the active revision {{revision}} first.
deadLetters.replayRevision: They run on their run’s revision.
deadLetters.replayHistory: Earlier attempts stay in each item’s history.
deadLetters.replayAgainOne: If it fails the same way, it comes back here as a new dead letter.
deadLetters.replayAgainOther: If they fail the same way, they come back here as new dead letters.
deadLetters.discardFinal: They leave the open dead letters for good: nothing replays them later.
deadLetters.discardRuns: Their runs record the loss and finish with errors.
deadLetters.discardHistory: The items and their history stay readable.
deadLetters.error: The dead letters could not be loaded.

empty.openBody: Every item reached the end of its path, or was filtered on purpose.
empty.otherBody: Dead letters land here once replayed or discarded.

deadLetters.keys: Keys: j and k move between rows, x selects, Shift R replays and Shift D discards the selection.

pipelines.paused: {{name}} paused: its deliveries wait until you resume it.
pipelines.files: Pipelines are files: edit their package, then
pipelines.error: The pipelines could not be loaded.

empty.title: No pipelines yet
empty.body: Pipelines are files. Run a package and it appears here within a second.

pipelines.pauseWait: No step starts a new delivery: they wait, pending, until you resume.
pipelines.pauseTriggers: Triggers still fire; their items wait with the rest.
pipelines.resumeStart: Every step starts its waiting deliveries again.
pipelines.resumeBudget: Pauses a budget made lift too; a step paused by hand stays paused.
pipelines.disableTriggers: Its triggers stop firing: scheduled times pass as skipped and are not caught up, and a manual run is refused.
pipelines.disableWait: Queued deliveries wait, pending, until you resume.
pipelines.disableRunning: Runs in flight keep their leases and finish what they hold.
pipelines.disabled: {{name}} disabled: its triggers are off and its deliveries wait until you resume it.
pipelines.resumeTriggers: Its triggers fire again from their next scheduled time; the times it skipped are not caught up.
pipelines.rollbackPick: Revision to reactivate in place of r{{revision}}
pipelines.rollbackNew: Runs started from now on use r{{revision}}.
pipelines.rollbackInFlight: Runs in flight finish on r{{revision}}.
pipelines.rollbackNoRevision: No new revision is created: r{{revision}} stays in the history, to roll forward to.
pipelines.rollbackNone: {{name}} has only its active revision, r{{revision}}: there is nothing to roll back to. Applying a package creates a new one.
pipelines.rolledBack: {{name}} rolled back to r{{revision}}: runs started from now on use it.

inbox.sampleExplained: Approved by the rule and already sent on. Your verdict only measures the rule: it recalls nothing and blocks nothing.
inbox.notePlaceholder: Add a note for the next reviewer
inbox.pickHint: Pick a reason, or press its number.
inbox.fixFields: Fix the highlighted field before approving.
inbox.undone: Undone: {{title}} is back in the queue.
inbox.lateFailed: Your decision on {{title}} didn’t go through after you left the inbox: {{message}}
inbox.lateConflict: Your decision on {{title}} wasn’t applied after you left the inbox: {{message}}
inbox.conflict: {{title}} was decided elsewhere or timed out.
inbox.decisionFailed: Your decision on {{title}} was not recorded, and the card is back.
inbox.linkGone: The review this link points to is no longer open: someone decided it, or it timed out.
inbox.zeroBody: Nothing waits for a decision. New items arrive with the next run.
inbox.disagreeTitle: Why do you disagree with the rule?
inbox.nextOpens: Next item opens after you decide

nodes.activeNote: Runs the pipelines; a standby engine takes over if it fails.
nodes.standbyNote: Ready to take over within about 30 seconds. The UI goes read-only during a handover.
nodes.readOnly: Read-only: this engine is the standby. Actions go to the active engine.
nodes.noneBody: Nothing can run until a node connects: millstream run starts one inside the engine.
nodes.table: Nodes, their labels, slots and leases
nodes.drainStops: The engine stops leasing deliveries to {{node}}.
nodes.drainFinishOne: It finishes the delivery it holds, then stays idle.
nodes.drainFinishOther: It finishes the {{n}} deliveries it holds, then stays idle.
nodes.drainIdle: It holds no delivery, so it goes idle at once.
nodes.drainRestart: It becomes active again when it is restarted.
nodes.drained: {{node}} is draining: it finishes what it holds, then stays idle until it is restarted.
nodes.revokeRefused: {{node}} is refused from now on and cannot rejoin under this id.
nodes.revokeLeasesOne: The delivery it holds ends at once, counting as a failed attempt, and goes to another node.
nodes.revokeLeasesOther: The {{n}} deliveries it holds end at once, each counting as a failed attempt, and go to other nodes.
nodes.revokeUndo: This cannot be undone: the machine can only rejoin under a new id.
nodes.revoked: {{node}} revoked: it can no longer rejoin under this id.
nodes.unschedulableNone: Every pending delivery has a node that can take it
nodes.unschedulableTable: Steps whose pending deliveries no node can take
nodes.unschedulableStandby: Known to the active engine only.
